MiniMax H3 Long Lip Sync - References -.description: Upload the complete soundtrack in Init Audio. Attach a portrait beside the prompt as @image1. Generate one 24 FPS video following the complete audio with native latent continuation. Default 832x1248, maximum 243-frame windows, 39-frame latent overlap, matching Turbo 4 LoRA. SOL and FirstBlockCache are independent optional approximations; both default off. No repeated pixel re-encoding; no guarantee of unlimited identity retention or perfect lip sync. Requires current ComfyUI, SECoursesAudioTools, ComfyUI-TeaCache and MiniMaxH3References extension 1.18.0. See the extension long-lip-sync guide.
